what: Standing knowledge for every person: authored places as boot facts; a required teaches() per registry subkind turning each witness's redacted copy into as-of location and holder facts about things other than the witness's own parts, appended in a known table beside the copy in record()'s transaction; an arrive whose present, set when the clock fires it and narrowed to the mover, teaches the arriver where everyone already there is; a latest-per-subject view and history; GET /api/knowledge/<person>; a Knowledge section in the bench with tick, source and a god's-eye stale marker; the fuzzer's replay and truth check over knowledge; a knows end state in the harness read over the route; and a knowledge goal set scored with the default model, with the three blind sets re-scored to new paths.
why: rudy closed the npc-knowledge exploration choosing baseline plus experienced knowledge, all true and as of the tick that taught it, as strata's second block, and decided at the gate that an arriver learns who is already in the room; nothing could show, test or score what an NPC knows; design: docs/work/npc-knowledge/design.md.
stakes: Every fact a person knows is an append-only row naming its tick and its source, the teaching event or authored at boot, and no row is ever updated or deleted.
What each subkind's copies teach is declared once, in its registry entry, and is required for every entry.

An arriver learns the room of every person already in the room it arrives in, as of the arrive tick, from its own copy, whose `present` is set when the clock fires the arrive; a bystander's copy drops it.
A taught fact is derived only from the witness's own redacted copy and is written in the same transaction as that copy, and the store refuses a taught row with no copy beside it.
Every fact matched the world at the tick that taught it, checked by the fuzzer's replay over every seeded run.
Knowledge holds no fact about a person's own location or an item it holds now; those are read from the location and holder parts, and ties from the ties part.
A reader gets the latest fact per (fact kind, thing), and every earlier fact stays readable in order.
The bench serves each person's knowledge on one route and shows it in a Knowledge section with tick, source and a stale marker, adding no control and no text the target's vocabulary reads.
A knows goal holds only when the knower's latest fact on that subject is not stale; an absent or stale fact never holds.
The harness reads knowledge only over the bench route and imports nothing from the engine or the server.
Nothing in the engine's rules or apply path reads whether a fact is stale.
Real runs use the default model, overwrite no committed score file, and their cost is named to the orchestrator before any is spent.

criteria.then: it is wrong if any person has a location or holder fact, or lacks a place or tie person: each person's facts are exactly kind place for back-room and chrome-cassette, tick 0, source authored, stale false; each person's people are its tie targets at tick 0 with source authored (glitch: rogue; mux: glitch; rogue: glitch); own location is its world location and own holdings its world item. The broken copy refuses boot with file people/mux.toml, path places.0, rule place-names-room, and creates no database file

mutations.change: skip initialKnown(defs) in Store.create so no authored rows are written
drop the place-names-room check from checkReferences
write each tie as a person fact row at boot instead of reading the ties part

mutations.change: make exchange.refuse teach its target's location {room: place}

outOfScope.summary: A bystander already in a room learns nothing about the others there from someone else's arrival, since `present` is narrowed to the arriver; it learns them when they act or are addressed.

frequency.records: physical.arrive events in corpus/runs/*/events.jsonl with two or more non-movers holding a copy in received.jsonl

outOfScope.summary: A refuse teaches nothing of the giver's location, and a lapse teaches nobody's location, since neither event guarantees who is in its room.

frequency.records: exchange.refuse and exchange.lapse events among all events in corpus/runs/*/events.jsonl

outOfScope.summary: Speech teaches only where its speaker and its addressee are; nothing said is learned as a fact, since being told is the gossip block's.

frequency.records: speech events among all events in corpus/runs/*/events.jsonl

outOfScope.summary: Every person's authored place list is both rooms of the two-room world, so place knowledge distinguishes no one yet.

frequency.reason: Authored content of three definition files, not a path any run or reader exercises differently.

outOfScope.summary: No decision reads knowledge yet; how it enters an NPC's snapshot waits for the mind and plan blocks.

frequency.reason: No decision path exists yet that could read it; the deferral is the exploration's (npc-knowledge.md Deferred).

outOfScope.summary: A knows end state is never served by a pending state's resolution, since a pending after carries no knowledge; the rule reaches it only through the plan's steps or Jev's choice.

frequency.reason: No committed goal has a knows end state; it bites only the new knowledge set, whose runs report it.

outOfScope.summary: Every loop's page text, read by Jev and by the target call, grows by the Knowledge section, and every target prompt by the two knows end states and the sentence on learning.

frequency.records: loops in corpus/runs/*/loops.jsonl, each of which reads the page

outOfScope.summary: Committed runs' events.jsonl hold arrive events without `present`; they are history read as files, never re-parsed against the registry, and are not rewritten.

frequency.records: physical.arrive events among all events in corpus/runs/*/events.jsonl, each committed without present
